From: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Cc: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Taxpayer ID details & PO setup for Vertex Ops

Carlos — thanks for the W-9. Quick heads-up: our tax team ran an automated EIN/name parity check and the legal name returned by the IRS database differs slightly from the name on your form (IRS lookup returned "Vertex Operations, LLC"). To proceed with PO creation we need one of the following: a corrected W-9 that exactly matches the IRS record, or an official bank letter on company letterhead that confirms the EIN and legal entity name.

Action items for you:
- Please resend a corrected W-9 if the legal name on your side should include the comma and period ("Vertex Operations, LLC").
- If you prefer not to reissue the W-9 immediately, send a bank letter or an IRS CP 575/147C copy that shows EIN 12-3456789 and the legal name.

Jordan — looping you in to confirm which GL account we should use for mapping once tax verification is complete.
Kimberly — tagging for any additional tax evidence we should accept.

We typically hold PO creation until the tax name/EIN is reconciled to avoid invoice/payment delays.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Hi Irene / team,

Appreciate the note. Attached is an updated W-9 with the legal name adjusted to "Vertex Operations, LLC" and a bank letter on letterhead confirming the EIN and account routing. The change was a clerical formatting difference on our side — apologies for the extra step.

Attachments: vendor_w9_signed.pdf (updated), vertex_bank_letter.pdf (pdf)

A couple logistics questions:
- Can you confirm the PO account code you plan to map? We will route invoices to accounts@vertexops.com and reference the PO number on remittance.
- Do we need to complete any additional vendor forms for ACH remittance?

Thanks — once you confirm PO details we will submit the first invoice within 5 business days.

Best,
Carlos Vega
Accounts Payable
Vertex Operations

From: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

Carlos — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the bank letter. Tax has verified that the EIN/name now reconciles. We have created PO PO-2027-1198 and mapped it to GL 5001-OP-Services (Operations / Cloud Services). Please find a PDF copy of the PO attached.

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt of the PO and that invoices will reference PO-2027-1198.
- Send invoice to invoices@redwoodinference.com with the PO number and we will process per Net 30 terms.

- Also please acknowledge the vendor master data in our portal: https://procurement.redwoodinference.com/po/PO-2027-1198

Attachments: PO-2027-1198.pdf (pdf)

Welcome to Redwood — looking forward to working together.
